en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The alarm system is off.
It must still be affected by the Electrobomb.

I should investigate this place thoroughly...
There must be some clues around here.

Phew... I think I'm starting to feel a little
better now.
I'm sorry to worry you, Shuichi.

Ah, I was a bit worried...
I'm glad you're feeling better.

<CLT=cltMIND>There was something I needed
to ask Keebo.

Hey, Keebo. Before we went into the
hangar this morning, you said...

So I went to the hangar last night and tried
to talk to him.
You tried to...talk to him on your own?

I'm sorry... I thought it would be preferable
for him to release Kaito peacefully...
How did it go?

It went about as well as I expected...
There was no response at all.
But I did witness a few things.

You said that you witnessed a few things.
What exactly did you see?

Ah, yes. Since we were in a hurry, I only told
you about the Exisal returning to the hangar...

Yes, you said the Exisals could pass through
the alarm system and barrier to the hangar.

I never imagined something like this would
happen, so I didn't mention it before...

But before I saw the Exisal, I saw <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone<CLT=typeNORMAL>
heading toward the hangar.
You saw <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone<CLT=typeNORMAL>?
I saw...Himiko.

I was in my lab, trying to think of what I
should write to convince Kokichi...

That's when I saw her walking toward the
hangar, clutching something in her hands...
I think it was a black bag.
A black bag?

At the time, I assumed she was going there
to examine things or plead with Kokichi.

And since she came back later, I didn't
think much of it...

But...after seeing her reaction this morning,
I started to get a little suspicious.
Wh-What? What...did you see?

She was acting like...she had something to
hide. It's not that I want to suspect her...
True, it is suspicious...
You said you saw her come back, as well...
Was she holding the bag at that time?
Now that I think about it...she didn't.

<CLT=cltMIND>So she had it coming in,
but not leaving...

<CLT=cltMIND>It has to be. That black bag Himiko
was carrying was—

By the way, this is a little off-topic, Shuichi,
but...
Huh? What is it?

The reason I wasn't feeling well may have
been due to the Electrobomb.

But it was because of the electromagnetic
particles, not because I'm a robot...

So what I experienced was akin to an
allergic reaction such as hay fever...

So it could have affected a human the same
way! Being a robot had nothing to do with it!
Ah, right...that must be it.

<CLT=cltMIND>So that thing Himiko said was bothering
him. He really is a bit too sensitive...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>K1-B0's Account<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Before I saw the Exisal enter the hangar
last night...
I saw Himiko heading toward the hangar.

While I was in my lab, trying to think of what
to write to convince Kokichi...

I saw her heading toward the hanger, clutching
what appeard to be a black bag.
A black bag?

At the time, I assumed she was going there
to examine things or plead with Kokichi.

And since she came back later, I didn't
think much of it...

But...after seeing her reaction this morning,
I started to get a little suspicious.
Wh-What? What...did you see?

She was acting like...she had something to
hide. It's not that I want to suspect her...
True, it is suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>And when Himiko was coming back,
she didn't have the black bag...

<CLT=cltMIND>She definitely had it with her when she
went in, but left empty-handed.

<CLT=cltMIND>The black bag Keebo saw...
must be...

<CLT=cltMIND>I've investigated thoroughly inside.
I should check around the hangar now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should get another look at
where the Exisals are.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's an Electrohammer here...
But why?

<CLT=cltMIND>Why would there be an
Electrohammer here?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's out of power.
It must have been used.
<CLT=cltMIND>But used for what...?

But, be careful. The Electrohammer runs
out of battery pretty quickly.

So if you use it against an Exisal, it'll run
out of juice with just one shot, got it?

If the Electrohammer's power is expended,
it requires 24 hours to recharge...
<CLT=cltMIND>We know that for certain...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Used Electrohammer<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
<CLT=cltMIND>I remember the sight I saw yesterday...

<CLT=cltMIND>Exisals protecting Monokuma
for some reason.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi said he was the mastermind,
the Exisals should have been around *him*.

<CLT=cltMIND>So why were they still protecting
Monokuma? And four of them, too...

I suppose I was so caught up thinking about
Kokichi, I ignored Monokuma...
Pay attention! Listen up! Take heed, I say!
Monokuma!?

It's just...I noticed that you came this way
last night, Shuichi.
Huh...?

Puhuhu... You were acting all sneaky, weren't
you?

Like a teenage boy tryin' to creep into the
adult movie section of the video store.

But you didn't need to sneak around, cuz
the Exisals wouldn't have attacked you.

...What are you saying?
We didn't have to sneak—

Cuz everyone's coming to rent adult movies, so
in a way, everyone going there is the same—

N-No, not *that*!
I meant about the Exisals not attacking us.

Oh, at the time, the Exisals were on auto-pilot
and directed to only observe me.

Their movements are more limited now that
the Monokubs aren't around to pilot them.

Autopilot? You mean...the remote control
that Kokichi has?
...Yeah, that's pretty much it.

<CLT=cltMIND>So the Exisals were being controlled
by Kokichi's remote control...
<CLT=cltMIND>but they were focusing on Monokuma?
...Why are you telling me all of this?

This puts the person controlling
you at a disadvantage.

But we're not talking about that...
We're talking about this.

Even if it puts someone at a disadvantage,
the class trial must always be fair.

The person who shared that info with me didn't
seem interested in sharing it with you guys...

So you share it instead! That way, it'll be
fair to all the participants!

<CLT=cltMIND>So someone else besides me
knows this...
<CLT=cltMIND>Why wouldn't they share this information?
Okaaaay! That's all I can tell you!

By the way, renting movies is so old school.
It's more thrilling to illegally download them...

It's like trying not to get caught by a big-game
hunter while holding your breath during sex!

<CLT=cltMIND>This information about the Exisals
could be a clue to solving this case...
<CLT=cltMIND>I should remember this.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Exisals Protecting Monokuma<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added
to the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why would there be an
Electrohammer here?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's out of power.
It must have been used.
<CLT=cltMIND>But used for what...?

out of battery pretty quickly.

So if you use it against an Exisal, it'll run

If the Electrohammer's power is expended,
it requires 24 hours to recharge...
<CLT=cltMIND>We know that for certain...
I remember the sight I saw yesterday...

<CLT=cltMIND>So the Exisals were being controlled
by Kokichi's remote control...
<CLT=cltMIND>but they were focusing on Monokuma?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi has control over the Exisals
with the remote control...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I don't understand why Monokuma
would tell me any of this.

<CLT=cltMIND>But someone else had this information,
and they kept it to themselves.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's what Monokuma said...

<CLT=cltMIND>Someone other than me knows,
and they're not telling.

<CLT=cltMIND>Could that person...be involved
in this case?
<CLT=cltMIND>This is the bathroom window.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the hangar's only window,
and it's not possible to fit through.

That means the only way to get
into this hangar is through the shutter.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is the bathroom window.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the hangar's only window,
and it's not possible to fit through.

<CLT=cltMIND>That means the only way to get
into this hangar is through the shutter.
<CLT=cltMIND>The hangar's shutter...
<CLT=cltMIND>There's a security alarm here.

<CLT=cltMIND>You have to use the alarm remote to disable
it to get near the shutter.

<CLT=cltMIND>If you come near the shutter
without the remote...

<CLT=cltMIND>A loud alarm would go off
around the entire academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>We had to use an Electrobomb
to disable the sensor and the alarm.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's how we got into the hangar.

Nee-heehee... It's not *exactly* a bomb, though.
Even if it is called an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Electrobomb<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

It jams electronic signals by scattering particles
that interfere with electromagnetic waves.

For two hours, any and all electronic devices
within 50 yards will be completely disabled.

It's perfect for any secret activities too,
since it doesn't leave any debris behind.

This invention is extraordinary! But I only
have three of them...

So I need to use them carefully. You guys will
have to settle for the Electrohammers.

<CLT=cltMIND>Now that I think about it...
there were three Electrobombs total.

<CLT=cltMIND>One was stolen by Maki,
but what of the other two?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Electrobomb<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the control panel that controls
the electric barrier protecting the hangar.

<CLT=cltMIND>We hit it with an Electrohammer,
so it isn't operational right now.

That's right...
What are these marks here?

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks as if it's been struck by
something sharp. What could these be?

Ah, wait...how were they even able
to damage this in the first place?

Getting near the control panel
should cause the alarm to go off.

You have to turn off the alarm
before you even get close...

<CLT=cltMIND>So how did the person who
did this get near the control panel?

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks as if it's been struck by

Ah, wait...how were they even able

<CLT=cltMIND>So how did the person who
did this get near the control panel?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
Perhaps I'll never get used to these after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>The Exisal isn't showing any
signs of moving.

<CLT=cltMIND>If Kokichi is alive, he can use his remote
control to move them as he pleases.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...that remote control Kokichi
has for the Exisals...

<CLT=cltMIND>What is it, exactly? Does he have that
because he's the mastermind?
<CLT=cltMIND>What exactly did I witness here...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I know for certain that the Exisals are
being controlled by Kokichi's remote control...
<CLT=cltMIND>But why were they focusing on Monokuma?

<CLT=cltMIND>That's about all I was concerned
with in the hangar...

But I still don't have enough clues...
There have to be more.

<CLT=cltMIND>The other places that might
yield some clues are...
Maki's lab...and my lab...

<CLT=cltMIND>The crossbow in the bathroom,
the bottle of poison...
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to investigate those leads.

I should also inspect the three Exisals
that were protecting Monokuma.

Why were they protecting him
in the first place?

That might be related to
the case as well.
